spans.s: दृक दृक, अम्, n. a hole, opening.

दृकाण दृकाण or दृक्काण or द्रेक्काण or
द्रेष्काण, अस्, m. (fr. the Gr. δέκανος), the third
part of a sign of the zodiac or a demi-god presiding
over it.

दृक्कर्ण दृक्-कर्ण, दृक्-कर्म, &c. See
under 2. दृश्, p. 429, col. 1.

दृक्ष दृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, looking, appearing,
having any aspect or appearance; (occurring in
comp. with certain pronominal bases, see अमू-द्˚,
ई-द्˚, की-द्˚, ता-द्˚; cf. 2. दृश् and दृश.)
